_readme: Every rule says how it is enforced. gate = a machine blocks it; scheduled = a job checks it on a timer; advisory = discipline only (say so honestly). gate and scheduled rules name the file that enforces them and a string that must appear in it; scripts/rules_check.py fails when an enforcer disappears.

rules.rule: A task cannot close without the five-item definition of done
Tasks are acknowledged within 24 hours and finished by their due date
Every workstream keeps a handoff record with all seven sections, updated after each key step
Only the reconciler decides whether a delivery arrived
At 90% of the weekly quota, stop starting changes; keep only what protects scheduled deliveries
